short_summary: Healthrate Inc.'s 2024 Form 1120 U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return, filed in October 2025, showing corporate details, headquarters address, officer Tim Michaels, and CPA R. Don Hobbs.
long_summary: The document is Healthrate Inc.'s 2024 Form 1120 U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return. It includes the company's legal name, headquarters address (734 Oriole Ln, Hudson, WI 54016), and identifies the corporate entity as a corporation. The filing lists Tim Michaels as an officer and R. Don Hobbs, CPA, as the preparer. The return contains schedules for compensation of officers, net operating loss carryover worksheets, and other tax computations. Business activity is coded under the Information Systems sector (NAICS 518210). The form also references net operating loss carryovers from prior years and includes standard tax filing instructions.
